statusDefinitions.BASE_DIRECT: Loaded directly by the application HTML before the additive runtime bootstrap. It may be foundational without owning the final visible UI.
statusDefinitions.FOUNDATION_REQUIRED: Current foundational shell or host layer required by later runtime owners. It may be visually superseded while still providing DOM, classes, globals or lifecycle hooks that later modules depend on.
statusDefinitions.FINAL_OWNER: Known current owner/finalizer for a visible runtime area. Later modules may still decorate it.
statusDefinitions.COMPATIBILITY: Required bridge, adapter, safety wrapper or migration layer. Do not infer UI ownership from this file.
statusDefinitions.LOADED_LEGACY_CANDIDATE: Still loaded in production but likely superseded in visible behavior. Must not be removed until callers, globals, events and smoke tests are traced.
statusDefinitions.LEGACY_FALLBACK_REQUIRED: Legacy layer intentionally retained because a current user-accessible fallback still depends on its behavior. Do not retire it until that fallback is removed or replaced.
statusDefinitions.ACTIVE_PROVIDER: Conditionally active runtime provider loaded outside the main bootstrap.
statusDefinitions.DYNAMIC_CURRENT: Current production module loaded dynamically by another current runtime file rather than by the main bootstrap.
statusDefinitions.LOADED_CURRENT_UNCLASSIFIED: Loaded by the production bootstrap and therefore treated as required until explicitly classified.

areas.note: Workspace Architecture provides the shell. Redesign Finalizer owner3 now requires current runtime generations for Home, Opportunities and tender dossier UI instead of accepting stale globals. Task Source Actions and Primary Navigation Resilience remain safe shell/navigation reconcilers.

Home Canonical remains the data/state foundation. Project Control Home v6 is the visible operator Home owner and must replace stale mounted generations; Home Live Sync keeps its bounded refresh adapter.

Project Classification is the final operational list-state presentation and final row-navigation owner: the whole visible project row opens the canonical project workspace, while the overflow menu remains separate. The legacy Hap action is hidden. Operational filters remain Albanian: Kërkon veprim, Në pritje, Në realizim and Të mbyllura.

Project Integrity UI owns the bounded base project load and minimal header. Project-First owns the visible project content and active shortcuts; Canonical Project Workflow reconciles workflow navigation over the existing engines. The post-award Execution Guard is the final lifecycle owner: won/execution projects cannot re-enter BOM, RFQ, supplier comparison, pricing or client-offer editing; those records remain historical while execution, finance, files and invoicing stay operational. Legacy header actions are not part of the daily surface. Project Commercial Simplified remains the final pre-award Commercial presentation/action owner. No ownership layer performs automatic outbound communication.

Contact Master is the final relationship register. Opening a contact refreshes that identity from pppp_contact_master_v1 so linked projects and project-email activity are current rather than stale cached counts.

Tender discovery engines remain backstage. Project-Centric Workflow is the single final visible whole-card Opportunities owner. KRPP/TED official sources are exposed as direct row-specific links when available; APP stays reference-based when no safe deep link exists. Official dossier download and technical/commercial analysis remain explicit actions before project creation is enabled. TED awards show winner role and contacts, with GC/EPC versus producer outreach handled differently. No tender becomes a project without a human decision.

GPT-OSS provider is dynamically loaded and becomes active only after explicit activation in the browser. Project Intelligence resilience remains the final analysis guard; the conversation module is an explicit, read-only discussion layer over the existing project brief and current PPPP data.
